limitations: In the small-type (odd) lines, fine marks of only a few pixels cannot be told apart reliably from patah or segol dots, even in the enlarged detail images. This is why the small-type meteg and dagesh questions above stay open, and why approval and all28_lines_verified stay false.
Under a patah, this font's wide bar can hide a joined meteg stroke or look like one. The L6, L10 and L24 questions turn on exactly this.
Human500–502 were not reopened. The pointing of שָּׁ and דָּ on L10, עֵינָי on L15 and אַחְבִּירָה on L18 is taken as settled.
No source, batch, XML or export acceptance is implied. No files were edited.
notes: All 15 provisional large-type meteg corrections have a separate stroke in the source image. Each is confirmed independently of the working text.

Lexical readings checked against the image match the working text on all 28 lines. They include וְעוֹלוֹתֵיכֶם (L9), וּבְלֵבָב (L11), מִזְבֵּחַ אֶבְנֶה and וַאֲשַׁבְּרָה with dagesh in ב (L14), הוֹדָיוֹתֶיךָ (L17), אֶעֱרוֹךְ (L19), לֵבָב (L21), וְרַב (L22), אֵיזוֹ (L24), חַי לֹא רָאֲךָ וְלֵב לֹא יְדָעֲךָ (L25) and לְבַדְּךָ (L27). The only exceptions are the open L11 and L25 questions above.

L22 גְדוֹלוֹת: in large type there is no dagesh in ג, unlike the plainly dotted גָּדוֹל in the same line. The working text without a dagesh is supported, and this item from fine-328's open questions is resolved.
L12 רוּחַ and L14 רוּחִי: I saw no meteg stroke at the ר or the shuruq. The primary draft's רֽוּחַ and רֽוּחִי are not supported, and the working text correctly leaves them out.

Punctuation checked against the image: a period after each first half-line and a colon at each line end, on all 28 lines. The running head 'שיר היחוד ליום ראשון' has no period. The margin page number '2' is left out of the text, correctly.
